title: Smooth motion
summary: VisualSmoother: visuals interpolate between 60 Hz physics ticks on the host and ease toward synced transforms on clients; 240 Hz smoothness test
claude_md: - Everything that moves and should look smooth is drawn under a {{#3D}}`VisualSmoother`{{/3D}}{{^3D}}`VisualSmoother2D`{{/3D}} (the camera too); logic reads the body, never the visual.
